preconditions.name: density_read_discriminates
preconditions.description: density(A) - density(B) clears floor (the density statistic the curiosity term routes on)

preconditions.name: selection_margin_responds_to_curiosity
preconditions.description: strong positive control (large curiosity_weight, dense A) yields a positive CEM score-MARGIN >= floor (the SAME margin statistic L1a/L1b route on)
preconditions.control: curiosity_weight=3.0, dense A vs sparse B

criteria.name: L1a_margin_on
criteria.note: continuous CEM score-margin (sparse - dense) under curiosity; > 0 <=> dense is the CEM elite; magnitude reflects drive strength (re-op of the saturating binary pref)

criteria.name: L1b_margin_propagation_delta
criteria.note: margin_on - margin_off; OFF counterbalances to ~0 -> the margin shifts with the drive

criteria.name: L1c_weight_independence
criteria.note: benefit weights zeroed -> value flat; density-driven margin unchanged (relative)

criteria.name: L2a_antiperseveration_margin
criteria.note: counterbalanced drop of the margin toward the familiarized region (WAKING)

criteria.name: L2b_mech094_replay_no_shift
criteria.note: is_waking=False must not raise familiarity -> margin unchanged
